_help: A 2024-rules background: three abilities (the player assigns +2/+1 or +1/+1/+1), one Origin feat, skills and a tool as effects, and starting equipment as options A/B.

backgrounds.name: River Guide
backgrounds.description: You ferried travelers and cargo along wild rivers.
backgrounds._help_feat: The feat id must exist: an SRD feat (alert, magic-initiate, savage-attacker, skilled) or one of your custom feats, imported first or in the same file.

equipment.label: A
equipment._help: 'item' is an item id (empty "" for something not in the item list); 'name' is what shows in the inventory.

feats.name: Lucky Break
feats.description: Once per Long Rest, when you fail a saving throw, you can reroll it and must use the new roll.
